experiments.purpose: Test whether per-instruction lookup miss handoff consumes the measured selective AOT payload advantage.
explanations: Per-instruction miss-to-driver transitions dominate the selective full-route loss.
The compiled payload or necessary fallback execution dominates even after transitions are batched.
experiments.outcome_a: Full differential passes and lookup misses fall from 21550 to approximately one per interpreter run; the route approaches or exceeds interpreter speed.
experiments.outcome_b: Any differential mismatch or continued large loss rejects the batched handoff as a viable correction.
